## Author checklist

- [ ] The change meets the linked requirement, and its purpose is clear.
- [ ] The scope is a coherent, reviewable unit; if large, it can be safely split or its size is explained.
- [ ] Relevant invalid inputs, boundaries, errors, and concurrency cases are handled.
- [ ] Tests cover expected behavior and important failure cases.
- [ ] Module boundaries and dependency direction are respected.
- [ ] Security, data handling, migrations, compatibility, and performance implications were considered; N/A is noted where appropriate.
- [ ] Documentation, metrics, and operational guidance were updated where needed; N/A is noted where appropriate.
- [ ] Required automated checks pass, or skipped checks and follow-up are explained.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, or local-only configuration were added.
